title: BitMEX sale collapsed as buyers balked at founder ownership and shrinking business
summary: Potential buyers, including Exodus, passed on BitMEX amid concerns over founder ownership and its shrinking business, according to a source familiar.

title: Bybit sues North Korea and Lazarus Group over $1.5 billion hack, secures asset freeze
summary: The exchange has secured a preliminary injunction freezing stolen assets.

title: OKX's Rafique doubts Clarity Act will pass, warns optimism is already priced into bitcoin
summary: The OKX executive says Democrats have little incentive to hand Republicans a crypto victory before the midterms.

title: How a five-second trick let traders drain millions from Polymarket
summary: After months of public warnings from onchain analysts, the prediction market is moving to time-weighted prices to make artificial price pushes too costly.

title: A part of FTX survived, and it’s the case for the CLARITY Act
summary: When FTX collapsed, the parts of it bound by law survived. Mainstream finance is now converging with digital assets, and the law built to protect it the same way is the one the Senate did not pass this week, argues Bullish's Randi Abernethy.
